messages:
maya: Quick green-sweep check for the model catalog launch tomorrow morning. I pulled together the final ownership list — can each owner confirm status (ok / blocker / need 1:1) for: licensing, perf profile, canary plan, and CRs?

maya: Owners: licensing=@cheng, perf=@eli, canary=@rachel, CRs=@ajay. Also tagging infra: @infra-bot for infra/rollout tickets.

cheng: Licensing: OK on main open-models (licenses reviewed). One note: arkiva-7b has a CLA ambiguity — legal is reviewing, ETA EOD today. Not a showstopper unless legal flags derivative terms.

eli: Perf: I ran the final perf sweep this morning. Quantized 8-bit batch profile looks good for p95 but tail latency spiked in long-seq tests.
eli: Concrete numbers: default profile (q4f) p50=22ms p95=95ms on g5.2x, quant8 p50=18ms p95=250ms for seq>1024.
eli: Action: recommend enabling prefix KV caching for long sequences and hold quant8 as fallback. I can post a config snippet.

maya: thanks. can you paste the config snippet @eli? we'll put it in the rollout notes.

eli: Sure — snippet for the runtime routes:
```
route_config:
  model_variant: "arkiva-7b-quant8"
  kv_cache: enabled
  kv_cache_policy:
    prefix_length_threshold: 256
    ttl_ms: 300000
  batching:
    max_batch_tokens: 4096
    prefer_latency: true
```
eli: TL;DR: turn on prefix caching and lower the batch max for that variant.

rachel: Canary plan: infra ticket INF-1729 created and assigned to me. Canary window is 2h in us-west2, gradual traffic ramp 1%->5%->20%. Rollback hook configured to fallback to rtrn/azul-7b if error rate > 1.5%. Dashboard widgets for latency/cost added.
rachel: Need @infra-bot to confirm scheduled maintenance window for node replacements during canary (timestamp).

infra-bot: infra-bot: Maintenance window confirmed: 2024-06-10T02:00:00Z - 04:00:00Z. No conflicting jobs for that region.

ajay: CRs: I merged the catalog metadata validation CR (PR #5234). One remaining PR for ingestion retry logic is pending review (PR #5267). I'll ping reviewers now. Should be merged before EOD.

ajay: Also added a small migration to ensure model tags include license SPDX ids.

maya: Perfect. Quick blocker tally:
- licensing: cheng (CLA ambiguity -> legal EOD)
- perf: eli (mitigation: prefix cache + fallback variant)
- canary infra: rachel / infra-bot (window confirmed)
- CRs: ajay (one PR pending review)

maya: If legal clears arkiva-7b and PR #5267 merges, we're go for the morning launch. Reply with "ok" when you have no outstanding actions or "blocker" if you need a 1:1.

cheng: ok (will follow up if legal finds issues).

eli: ok — I'll add the runtime snippet to the rollout doc and schedule a final perf probe at +30m.

rachel: ok, infra watch on the canary and will run the preflight checks 30m before rollout.

ajay: blocker -> PR #5267 needs one more review from @maya or @cheng (small retry backoff tweak). If you can approve I can merge.

maya: reviewing PR #5267 now, will approve in 10m if no surprises.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: Preflight checks: model artifact checksums valid, quotas OK, secrets OK.

maya: thanks all. I'll assemble a 1-line launch note for the #announcements channel once we have green across the board. If anything changes ping this thread. :thumbsup:

cheng: quick heads-up — if legal flags arkiva we should have a fallback image mapping to arkiva-lite in the catalog. I can add that mapping now as a precaution.

eli: good plan. adding the mapping keeps rollout smooth.

maya: adding to checklist: fallback mapping for arkiva -> arkiva-lite. Assigning to @cheng as low-priority preflight.

ajay: merged PR #5267. all green on CRs.

maya: OK green sweep complete from my side. final status: licensing=ok (pending legal confirmation), perf=ok (mitigations in place), canary=scheduled, CRs=merged. Launch proceeding contingent on legal EOD.

maya: Thanks team — will post launch note or abort if legal flags anything.
